channel.title: Africa Election News | AfroTools
channel.description: Neutral, dated official-source election briefs from AfroTools.

item.title: Cabo Verde court admits sixth presidential bid
item.description: CNE says a 24 September court appeal ruling admitted Loisito Tavares de Sousa, bringing the 15 November presidential field to six.

item.title: Cabo Verde's initial court decision admitted five candidacies before appeal
item.description: The CNE's 22 September notice described five candidacies admitted by the initial decision. A 27 September notice reports that an appeal brought the admitted count to six; this brief preserves the earlier decision.

item.title: South Africa: Special-vote applications close 12 Oct
item.description: The Electoral Commission says applications opened on 21 September for special votes ahead of the 4 November local elections. The deadline is 17:00 on 12 October.
